title: Researcher-to-Flora portable Twin translation audit and upload-screen change record
objective: Expose the current Codex sprint purpose and test status on the main Twin upload screen while documenting the Researcher-to-Flora translation boundary without changing semantic translation behaviour.
implementation_summary: Added a pilot-only CURRENT PILOT CHANGE panel to the existing Flora Twin upload page.
Added governed source documentation auditing the TEL-001 Researcher-to-Flora translation path.
Did not modify TEL-001, validation, governance, promotion, adapters, semantic construction or Observation logic.
expected_visible_outcomes: The /blueprint-import page shows sprint purpose, claimed output, deployed commit, branch, timestamp, diagnostics link and operator test steps.
The panel separates Codex claim, deployed runtime evidence and operator validation result.
The panel warns when the latest imported candidate appears older than the deployment or when timestamp evidence is unavailable.
unchanged_behaviour: Blueprint package acceptance and validation remain unchanged.
Candidate staging, semantic assembly, Observation generation, owner assessment, Research Gaps, promotion and governance remain unchanged.
required_test_steps: Open /blueprint-import in the deployed Flora runtime.
Confirm the CURRENT PILOT CHANGE panel is visible before upload.
Confirm deployed SHA, branch/release, timestamp, claimed output, expected visible change and diagnostics link are readable.
Import or select a Twin and confirm whether stale-candidate and fresh-import/restage guidance is shown accurately.
Record the operator validation result as Not yet tested, Visible change confirmed, No visible change, Partially successful, Failed, Stale candidate or Requires fresh import.
known_limitations: Operator validation cannot be inferred from repository tests and defaults to Not yet tested.
Fresh-import guidance depends on deployment timestamp and import timestamps being available in runtime metadata.
This sprint documents remediation only; it intentionally does not fix semantic translation gaps.
